Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class FileTransfer

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.FileTransfer
public final class FileTransfer extends Object
The pure state of one file transfer, in either direction. This is the model half of the file-transfer feature: it holds the identity, name, size, expected SHA-256, the byte count, and a small guarded state machine (OFFERED -> ACCEPTED -> IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED, with REJECTED/CANCELLED/FAILED as terminal off-ramps). It performs no I/O and touches no socket - FileTransferManager drives it and the UI observes it - so every transition is unit-testable headless.

Instances are thread-safe: the sending worker thread and the channel's reader thread may both advance the same transfer, so the mutators are synchronised and the frequently-read counters are volatile. Transition methods return whether the move was legal, so a caller can tell a real state change from a late or duplicate signal (for example a FILE_END after a cancel).
